Each alien has a specific number of hands, and they will attempt to disinfect all of their hands. If there is not enough disinfectant left for an alien to disinfect all of their hands when they start, they will use up the remaining disinfectant, and no further aliens can disinfect their hands.
fix_specification_reasoning.diagnosis_and_repair_directions: The flawed specification incorrectly interprets the problem. It checks if each element in the list H is greater than M, which is not relevant to the problem. Instead, it should check if the cumulative number of hands that have been disinfected exceeds M. The specification should iterate over each alien, subtract the number of hands they have from M, and stop when M is less than the number of hands of the current alien. The counter should increment for each alien that successfully disinfects all their hands.
